title: REQ · Admin console displays the current World title
summary: AdminApp fetches the World and shows its title
description: The backend serves GET /api/v1/worlds/{id} returning {id,title} (world.World). AdminApp should fetch it with a client function and display the title in the heading, falling back to WORLD_ID until loaded or on failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given GET /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room returns a title, when AdminApp renders after token entry, then the heading contains that title.
Given the world request fails, when AdminApp renders, then the heading still shows WORLD_ID and the page does not crash.
